ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones located on the distal sections of the left and right lobes, characterized by internal dark-pixel mottling and surrounded by a dominant low-intensity black central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 70 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with approximately 10-15 distinct peaks per lobe, featuring pixel-amplitudes that increase toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curve along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp convex sweep at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-intensity pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes; secondary dark circular spots are embedded within the white patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible as diagonal rake marks on the left lobe white patch and vertical streaks on the right lobe white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters on the distal tips and visible linear rake mark scarring across the pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Symmetric, isolated dark circular ocelli located in the upper-lateral quadrants of the white pigmentation on both lobes.
